findings.detail: A restored generated midpoint with no cancellation/fault marker is advertised as audit-only. Calling public await_cancel with valid incoming command or replay_control with clock.command reaches _cancel and writes control-observed/cancel-intent/cancelled/control-ack. This contradicts all-restores read-only / no-new-effects narrowing, even though no model rerun occurs. Existing cancelled recovery test is masked by terminal markers and does not expose this path.
findings.fix: Reject restored read-only views before any polling or _cancel side effect in every public effect entrypoint; retain check in publish. Add minimal current live midpoint restored-view negatives before cancellation so terminal guard cannot mask readonly failure, verify no journal/backend changes and no command consumption.
findings.location: live_core.restore sets _live_readonly; publish checks it, await_cancel/replay_control do not

findings.detail: It validates intent/final wire against pinned oldwire and first.route==last.route, but never requires these routes to equal independently reconstructed oldroute with currentartifact/requestidentity (or exact acknowledged midpoint route). Two mutually matching changed numeric routes would satisfy this portion if checksums/refs supplied consistently. verify earlier midpoint does not carry its route into this later check. Not external authentication, but insufficient independent producer-output consistency versus stated complete route binding.
findings.fix: Independently reconstruct expected route in verify_ack as verify does and compare both cancelled/intent routes exactly (including current request/artifact/feature/value/action). No new model call needed.
